江尘摸了摸江能文的头：“下次二叔进城，给你带烧鸡吃！”
江能文瞪大双眼，紧紧抓着江尘的衣袖。
侄女江晓芸翻了个大白眼：“你是傻子吗？二叔的话你也信。”
江能文瞬间想起之前的事，松开了抓着江尘的手。
之前的江尘，连两个侄子侄女的口粮都不知道抢了多少，还拿家里的吃的送给那个叫陈花的，有烧鸡怎么会给他们吃。
江尘看着两个孩子出去，只能感叹他真是一点好形象没有啊，也就老爹把他当个宝了。
“不过……等他从山上下来，虽说没有烧鸡，但总会有只兔子，晚上就吃炖兔肉吧。”
将碗放下，江尘抬头开口：“爹，我上小黑山一趟。”
江有林皱眉：“你去小黑山干什么？”
江田也开口：“才下过雪，山路那么难走，你最近都别出门了。”
“我去山上看看，要是能抓到什么野物，晚上就能吃肉了。”
江田顿时气急：“你说胡话呢？你连弓都不会拉，还想打猎？”
“我就碰碰运气，不行就打点柴。”
江田哪里信他是去打猎，起身抓住江尘的衣服。
江尘扯了两下没扯开，也不知如何解释。
他自小被家里好吃好喝的供着，年纪不大，却比江田高出一头。
这回头一瞪，竟将江田吓得连退两步：“你......别让爹担心了行不行！”
江尘看向坐着的江有林，也想撑着拐杖站起来。

最终也只能说了一句：“爹，我很快回来。”
江有林叹了口气，还是喊住了江尘：“小尘，外边冷，你把爹的狗皮袄穿上。”
狗皮袄是冬狗皮鞣制的厚皮袄，每年冬天江有林就穿着上山，比普通棉服暖和的多。
江尘看了一眼挂在墙上的狗皮袄，说了一句：“我天黑之前回来。”
说完后，套上狗皮袄，迎着风走了出去。
江田看着他的背影，深深叹了口气，无力坐下。
江有林用拐杖撑着站起来，有些颓唐的走回房间。
江能文看着江尘的背影问道：“爹爹，二叔去打猎，是不是能带回肉吃啊？”
他还记得，爷爷还能上山打猎时，家里不时能吃上肉，就算是不好卖的下水，那也是肉啊。
可从爷爷受伤后，家里再没有吃过肉了。
江晓芸白了他一眼：“你真是傻子，二叔就算打到肉，也不会给我们吃的。”
江田神色一冷：“不准这么说你二叔，有没有规矩！”
陈巧翠把两个孩子护到怀里：“你也找时间上山，看能不能多打点柴。
这天气越来越冷，拿到县城还能卖点钱。”
他本来也有这打算，可现在心里最急的是借粮。
借粮啊……这年节，只能找村里正，也就他家有多余的粮食外借。
要是明年还不上......少了一亩田是要被骂败家子的。
江有林进屋，陈巧翠起身收拾碗筷，又低声说了一句：“二郎会不会把狗皮袄拿去当了啊，那皮袄值不少钱呢。”
江田陡然警醒：“他肯定不是去山上，是进城，我去追！”
不过江田是往县城追，江尘却是真的往山里去，两人自然是碰不上的。

> Chapter 3 Going up the mountain (page 1)
Jiang Chen touched Jiang Nengwen's head: "Next time my second uncle comes to town, I will bring you roast chicken to eat!"
Jiang Nengwen's eyes widened and he clutched Jiang Chen's sleeve tightly.
Niece Jiang Xiaoyun rolled her eyes: "Are you a fool? You also believe what my second uncle said."
Jiang Nengwen instantly remembered what happened before and let go of Jiang Chen's hand.
Before, Jiang Chen even robbed his two nephews and nieces of how much food they had, and even gave the family food to Chen Hua. How could he give them roast chicken?
Jiang Chen watched the two children go out and could only sigh that he really didn't have a good image at all. It was only his father who regarded him as a treasure.
"But... when he comes down from the mountain, although there will be no roast chicken, there will always be a rabbit. Let's eat rabbit meat stew in the evening."
Putting the bowl down, Jiang Chen raised his head and said, "Dad, I'm going to Xiaohei Mountain."
Jiang Youlin frowned: "Why are you going to Xiaoheishan?"
Jiang Tian also spoke: "It has just snowed. The mountain road is so difficult to walk. You have not gone out recently."
"I'll go to the mountains to see if I can catch any wild animals, so I can eat meat at night."
Jiang Tian suddenly became furious: "Are you talking nonsense? You can't even draw a bow, and you still want to hunt?"
"I'll try my luck. If it doesn't work, I'll get some firewood."
Jiang Tian didn't believe that he was going hunting, so he stood up and grabbed Jiang Chen's clothes.
Jiang Chen pulled it twice but didn't pull it away, and didn't know how to explain it.
He has been provided with good food and drinks at home since he was a child. Although he is not very old, he is a head taller than Eda.
This glance back made Jiangtian so frightened that he took two steps back: "You... don't make dad worry, okay?"
Jiang Chen looked at Jiang Youlin who was sitting and wanted to stand up with his crutches.
In the end, all he could say was: "Dad, I'll be back soon."
Jiang Youlin sighed, but still called out to Jiang Chen: "Xiao Chen, it's cold outside, put on dad's dog-skin coat."
The dog skin jacket is a thick leather jacket made from winter dog skin. Jiang Youlin wears it when going up the mountain every winter. It is much warmer than ordinary cotton clothes.
Jiang Chen glanced at the dog skin coat hanging on the wall and said, "I'll be back before dark."
After saying that, he put on his dog fur coat and walked out into the wind.
Jiang Tian looked at his back, sighed deeply, and couldn't sit down.
Jiang Youlin stood up with crutches and walked back to the room dejectedly.
Jiang Nengwen looked at Jiang Chen's back and asked, "Dad, my second uncle went hunting, can I bring back some meat to eat?"
He still remembered that when his grandfather could still go hunting in the mountains, the family could eat meat from time to time. Even if it was fish that was not easy to sell, it was still meat.
But since my grandfather was injured, the family has never eaten meat again.
Jiang Xiaoyun rolled her eyes at him: "You are such a fool. Even if my second uncle gets the meat, he won't give it to us to eat."
Jiangtian looked cold: "Don't say that to your second uncle, are there any rules?"
Chen Qiaocui held the two children in her arms: "You should also find time to go up the mountain and see if you can collect more firewood.
The weather is getting colder and colder. If you get it to the county town, you can still make some money. "
He originally had this plan, but now the most urgent thing on his mind is borrowing food.
Borrowing food... This Chinese New Year, I can only ask the village chief, and he is the only one who has extra food to borrow.
If you don't get it next year...if you lose an acre of land, you will be called a prodigal.
Jiang Youlin entered the room, and Chen Qiaocui stood up to put away the dishes and chopsticks, and whispered: "Could Erlang have pawned the dog-skin coat? That fur coat is worth a lot of money."
Jiangtian suddenly became alarmed: "He is definitely not going to the mountains, but entering the city. I will chase him!"
However, Jiang Tian was chasing towards the county town, but Jiang Chen was really heading into the mountains, so the two of them naturally couldn't run into each other.
